cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

mechanism: A makes escalating tiny assembly favors look like checks of a pupil remembered technique until B completes the job.
confusable: Not assigning the whole task openly: each lesson-sized request grows from what B has already done.
comparison: Shelf installation under a departure limit versus bouquet help that naturally absorbs the finishing work.
seedUse: Use D25 bracket/screw/shelf progression; S05 claimed tool teaching grades each success before asking a little more.
